WHEN THE ATLAS DOESN'T HAVE YOUR FIX

Make a starting guide for your repair.

Tell Theseus what you have and what happened. Gemini can draft a cautious path to investigate, with tools, safety checks, and searches for parts and videos.

AI drafts can be wrong. Check the exact model and manufacturer instructions before opening, wiring, or ordering anything.

Describe the fix

The more specific you are, the more useful the guide can be.

Your description is sent to Google's Gemini API to create the draft. Theseus does not save it in an account.

✳

What you'll get

  • A safety check before any repair step
  • A short diagnosis and clear ordered steps
  • Tools and possible parts to verify
  • Search links for parts, videos, and expert guides

No exact product listing or video is invented. Search results may still need checking.
